napIntro.text:
* The pie has not
  cooled down yet.

napPrompt.text:
* Perhaps you should
  take a nap.

chatStart.text:
* You'd rather stay
  up and chat with
  me, then?

chat.text:
* Um, I want you to know
  how glad I am to
  have someone here.

* There are so many
  old books I want
  to share.

* I want to show you
  my favorite bug-
  hunting spot.

* I've also prepared
  a curriculum for
  your education.

* This may come as
  a surprise to you...

* But I have always
  wanted to be a
  teacher.

* ... actually, perhaps
  that isn't very
  surprising.

* I am glad to have
  you living here.

nothing.text:
* Well, talk to me
  again if you
  need anything.

home.text:
* What?
* This... this IS your
  home now.

* Um... would you like
  to hear about this
  book I am reading?

bookAgain.text:
* Did you want to
  hear about the
  book I am reading?

book.text:
* It is called
  "72 Uses for Snails."

factIntro.text:
* Here is an exciting
  snail fact.

factAvoid.text:
* Um...
* How about an exciting
  snail fact?

facts.text:
* Have a chainsaw-like
  tongue called a
  radula?

* Sometimes flip their
  digestive systems
  as they mature?

* Talk. Really. Slowly?
* Just kidding, snails
  don't talk.

bother.text:
* Well, bother me
  if you need anything
  else.

leave.text:
* ... I have to do
  something.
* Stay here.

anything.text:
* If you need anything,
  just ask.

empty.text:
* (Seems like the right size
  for Toriel.)

fire.text:
* The fire isn't burning hot...
* Just pleasantly warm.
* You could put your hand inside.

tools.text:
* The ends of the tools have
  been filed down to
  make them safer.

history.text:
* It's a history book.
* Here's a random page...

* Trapped behind the barrier
  and fearful of further
  human attacks, we retreated.

* Far, far into the earth
  we walked, until we reached
  the cavern's end.

* This was our new home,
  which we named...

* As great as our king is,
  he is pretty lousy at
  names.

fridge.text:
* For some reason, there
  is a brand-name chocolate
  bar in the fridge.

sink.text:
* There is some white fur
  stuck in the drain.

pieHot.text:
* What a nice smell...
* Too hot to eat, though.

pieSlice.text:
* The size of the pie
  intimidates you too much
  for you to eat it.

pieEnd.text:
* (Most of the pie is gone.)
* (There are dog prints in
  it...)

cupboard.text:
* Inside the cupboard are
  cookie cutters for
  gingerbread monsters.

stove.text:
* The stovetop is very clean.
* Toriel must use fire
  magic instead.

stoveAfter.text:
* No one will use this
  anymore...
